item.tib: byang chub bsgrub (sgrub) thabs kyi bon tshigs su bcad pa sum brgya pa'i ti ka gsal ba'i sgron me
item.coloph: ces byang chub sgrub thabs kyi bon tshigs su bcad pa sum brgya sum bcu pa'i ti ka gsal ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba 'di ni/ ston pa rin chen bzang po sogs don gnyer can mang pos snga nas bskul zhing / phyis mngon mtho'i dpal du mas brgyan zhing / nges par legs pa'i lam la yid ches thob pa'i dbon po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba sogs de rnams kyi don du/sgos su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa'i dge bshes shes rab 'od zer gyi don du/ rgyal rong ba rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis/ chu bo gser ldan gyi 'gram gangs dkar gnyan po'i rgyab zur gyi nags khrod du sbyar ba'o//
